title: Initial Ends of Parabolic Nodal Curves
summary: The draft studies how nodal curves of solutions to one-dimensional linear parabolic equations approach the initial time. It considers initial endpoints and cluster sets associated with those curves.
focus_points: Nodal curves for one-dimensional linear parabolic equations
Behavior of nodal curves near the initial time

title: Sharp vanishing order for biharmonic equations with bounded potentials
summary: The draft studies normalized vanishing-order bounds for the biharmonic equation Δ²u + Vu = 0 with bounded potentials. It develops proposed real-valued sharpness constructions using annular gluing, clamped replacement, and averaging that preserves biharmonic functions.
focus_points: Normalized vanishing orders and bounded potentials

title: Sharp uniform Landis estimates for the biharmonic equation
summary: The draft studies quantitative unique continuation at infinity for the biharmonic equation Δ²u + Vu = 0. It explores proposed radius-dependent constructions in connection with uniform Landis-type decay estimates.
focus_points: Proposed radius-dependent constructions for the biharmonic equation
